title: Design System: ABAP-Studio — The System Manifest

logon-display.purpose: The single access-hero statement; largest type in the product.

headline.purpose: Access coupon titles on logon and Clerk surfaces.

title.purpose: Panel and section headings inside the manifest.

body.purpose: Descriptions and record text; measure at or under 620px.

label.purpose: Panel titles, table headers, buttons, nav counts, and field labels.

meta.purpose: Protected-record notes and dense row annotations.

numeral.purpose: Coupon values and scannable metrics; tabular figures.

control.purpose: Base size handed to the Clerk identity widget.

shadows.name: printed-edge
shadows.purpose: A printed hairline under manifest panels at rest.

shadows.name: access-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the single access coupon off the navy hero field.

shadows.name: dot-seat
shadows.purpose: Directional seat under live status dots; never a colored halo.

motion.name: stamp-land
motion.purpose: The only authored motion: the validation stamp settles into place with a scale, never a fade, so text contrast holds throughout.

motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Border and 1px lift on coupon hover; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion, stamp animation and coupon/nav transitions are disabled.

narrative.overview:
The product is a working record, not a dashboard. Every account, program, and run is a line in a manifest that an owner keeps current: entries are numbered, states are stamped, and changes leave a mark. The visual system borrows the physical grammar of a validated manifest — perforated edges, coupon stubs, steel rules, carbon numerals, and a rotated stamp — and renders it in the SAP palette the workbench already owns.

Density is deliberate. The owner surface is read at a glance and operated with small, precise controls; the access surface is one confident statement beside one calm coupon. Both share the same stock: pale #F4F7FA surface, white paper records, navy structure, SAP blue action. The world is flat and printed, with exactly one authored motion — the validation stamp landing.

Confirmed rejections: rounded SaaS cards, gradient text, colored side-stripe accents, decorative kickers above headings, and faux paper texture. The manifest is crisp stock, not a prop.
keyCharacteristics: Navy structural frame with a pale work surface and white paper records.
Square corners everywhere except the circular validation check and the perforation notches.
Azeret Mono for every label, numeral, code, and stamp; Archivo for every sentence.
One rotated stamp per surface; one authored motion, disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Stamped-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red appear only on records that actually carry that state. A neutral row stays ink on paper; state color is information, not styling.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: SAP Blue marks action and live emphasis. If two elements in a view compete for it, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Carbon Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number a user might compare or scan — metrics, counts, durations, timestamps, client numbers — is set in Azeret Mono with tabular figures. Prose numbers stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No label, eyebrow, or kicker sits above a heading. The heading carries its own weight; labels belong to controls and records, not to headlines.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Records do not float. If a surface needs a shadow to be understood, the structure is wrong; fix the rule and the layering first.

dos: Do keep every corner at 0px except the validation check and perforation notches.
Do set all labels, numerals, codes, and timestamps in Azeret Mono with tabular figures.
Do use SAP Blue for one action per view and keep it off neutral records.
Do express state with the soft-ground status chip or the pale #FCF7BE selected line, never with a side stripe.
Do separate the rail and access card with a 1px dashed rule and 12–13px circular notches.
Do keep one rotated validation stamp per surface and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do preserve a visible 2px focus outline on every interactive element.
donts: Don't add kickers, eyebrows, or labels above headings; the heading starts the block.
Don't round cards, buttons, inputs, or chips.
Don't use colored side-stripe accents, gradient text, or colored halos as decoration.
Don't introduce a second accent hue beyond SAP blue and the validation green/amber/red vocabulary.
Don't add motion beyond the stamp landing; no parallax, scroll reveals, or hover choreography.
Don't invent a faux paper texture, drop shadow stack, or skeuomorphic chrome.
Don't truncate audit detail text on phones; wrap it instead.
